_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales held flat at $4,854 (+0.3%) while ad spend fell 19% to $1,074. The Variety 12 Pack grew 31% to $2,520 and Cherry Blossom grew 39%, offsetting Mexican Cerveza, which fell 56% to $406.
refunds: Refunds rose to $169.58 (6 units) from $48.08. $118.74 of it (4 units) is the 19.2oz Mexican Lager Tallboy, which had no sales and no stock this week. Worth checking its return reasons.
pacing_reco: Only Nov 1 is in, so the month projection is rough. Holding October's run rate ($24,197) depends on fixing Mexican Cerveza's Buy Box and keeping the Variety Pack in stock.
ads_context: The Oct 5–11 week ran at 87.9% ACoS and 32.2% TACoS.
Since then spend has come down each week; this week ACoS was 61.8% and TACoS 22.1%, the lowest of the last four weeks.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $342.90 on $103.63 (30.2% ACoS) for 14 orders.
Category keywords cost $711.77 for $1,143.75 (62.2% ACoS); remarketing spent $189.63 for $153.16 (124% ACoS).
bid_moves: Lower the bid on “na beer” (exact): $154.65 for $231.92, 66.7% ACoS.
Pause or negate “non alcoholic beers” exact in the Mexican Cerveza campaign: $50.07, 14 clicks, no sales.
promotions: This week: 58 promotion orders and $287.76 in promotional discounts (vs 65 and $283.39 last week).
Subscribe & Save orders: 22 this week vs 32 last week.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: keep the Variety 12 Pack (6.0 weeks available, 2,318 inbound) stocked through BF/CM.
reviews_body: Sellerise returned no review records, rating trend or negative reviews for the 7 RationAle products over the last 90 days.
That means the review tracker isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for RationAle in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report) so the deck can show rating and review count per product.
Read the newest 1–3 star reviews on the Tallboy, where 4 of this week's 6 refunded units came from.
recommendations: Check the Buy Box lost on Mexican Cerveza 6 Pack (alert Oct 29); its sales fell 56% to $406.
Pause the Mexican Cerveza [Hyper] exact campaign while the Buy Box is out: $52.91 spent, no sales.
Lower bids on “na beer” exact (66.7% ACoS) and cut the 33 campaigns with spend and no sales ($194.96).
Add “athlete non alcoholic beer 12 pack” as an exact keyword: 3 orders and $115.96 from $4.91.
Review remarketing (Sponsored Display at 128% ACoS) and move budget to branded keywords at 30.2% ACoS.
Decide on the 19.2oz Tallboy: 0 available, 0 inbound, 75 sold in the last 30 days.
Fix the dimensions alerts on the Variety 12 Pack and Kolsch listings.
Plan BF/CM coupons and deals (Nov 27–30) and confirm submission deadlines.
position: October closed at $24,197; November is $535 after day one.
